description: This file implements various bitwise operations such as AND, OR, XOR, left shift, and right shift for a spreadsheet calculation library. It supports array inputs and handles argument validation and error cases.

classes.name: BitWise
classes.description: A class providing bitwise operation functions for spreadsheet calculations, supporting array inputs and argument validation.

methods.name: BITAND
methods.description: Performs bitwise AND of two integer values, supporting array inputs.

methods.name: BITOR
methods.description: Performs bitwise OR of two integer values, supporting array inputs.

methods.name: BITXOR
methods.description: Performs bitwise XOR of two integer values, supporting array inputs.

methods.name: BITLSHIFT
methods.description: Shifts a number left by a specified number of bits, supporting array inputs.

methods.name: BITRSHIFT
methods.description: Shifts a number right by a specified number of bits, supporting array inputs.

methods.name: validateBitwiseArgument
methods.description: Validates that the argument is a numeric value suitable for bitwise operations.

methods.name: validateShiftAmount
methods.description: Validates that the shift amount is numeric and within the valid range.

methods.name: nullFalseTrueToNumber
methods.description: Converts null, false, or true to numeric values 0 or 1.
